reuse_baseline.policy: Reuse identity-verified metadata and accepted full-text Evidence Cards; re-screen conclusions and scope under the revised Research Brief; search only unresolved coverage gaps.

saturation_criteria: All reused and newly retrieved deduplicated candidates have a final title/abstract screening decision.
At least two complementary recent review searches add no unrepresented major impedance-control method family.
The pre-2021 high-citation backbone in the reused corpus is either represented by decision-grade full-text evidence or explicitly excluded with a scientific reason.
A second page for each 2021-2026 target venue adds no new major mechanism family or unresolved transition.
Targeted follow-up closes every material gap recorded in the coverage review or explicitly records why it remains open.

coverage_gaps: Independent recent-review triangulation beyond the reused 2020 Variable Impedance Control and Learning review.
Explicit re-screening of all 171 legacy candidates under the narrowed impedance-control-only brief.
Full-text decision-grade coverage of missing foundational and high-citation impedance-control backbone papers already present in the legacy corpus.
Venue-bounded 2021-2026 coverage of recent impedance-control and impedance-learning mechanisms, with abstract screening for all retrieved candidates.

Evidence-based characterization of developments after early learning-based variable impedance control, including stability/passivity-certified, model-based, data-efficient, and contact-rich directions where supported.
